title: Tourist at Home
old_caption: Waiting for the next big trip to feel alive? Ride three stops, find the mural you always walked past, try the food stall. Adventure starts close to home.

title: The Class Alone
old_caption: Skipping things because no friend can come? Take the class alone. The bowl might lean, and it will still be the one you made yourself.

title: Be Your Own Crush
old_caption: Lonely on a Friday night? Do what you'd do for a crush: candles, the good pasta, a sweet note. Then be the one who writes back to you.

title: Cooking for Company
old_caption: Cooking for one can feel a bit sad. Make the family recipe anyway, set the table properly, light the candle. You count as company.

title: Wobble Proudly
old_caption: Everyone at the rink seems to be in pairs this time of year. Go anyway. Wobble, fall a little, find your glide, then buy yourself the cocoa.

title: The Free Show Upstairs
old_caption: Swap the 2 a.m. scroll for the sky. On a clear winter evening, find Orion's belt and follow it to Aldebaran. The best show tonight is free and open to one.

title: A Whole Saturday, Just Me
old_caption: A to-do list with one item on it. Slow coffee, flowers, a nap with no guilt, then the last thing on the list. Rest counts as something you did. Save this for your next free Saturday.

title: Solo Day Trip
old_caption: Scared to go somewhere with nobody to talk to? Take the train anyway. Look, listen, let a stranger's dog say hi. Stay for the ending: the voice note goes to someone who deserves it.

title: Beginner on Purpose
old_caption: Hate being bad at things? Seven attempts, a lot of falling and one kind tip from a stranger. Being a beginner is where every good thing starts.

title: The Unbirthday
old_caption: Waiting for someone else to celebrate you? Bake the cake on a Tuesday, dance to your own playlist, and write yourself the card. You don't need a reason.
